authors: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
title: Probabilistic characterization of blending with LSST and application to cluster lensing cosmology
summary: Next-generation galaxy surveys, like the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), will deliver unprecedented depth and sky coverage, enabling precise measurements of cosmic probes such as weak lensing and galaxy clustering. However, increased imaging depth leads to significant blending of galaxy images, particularly in dense fields like galaxy clusters. This blending, exacerbated by atmospheric blurring in ground-based observations, contaminates galaxy property measurements and causes source confusion. To simultaneously capture these effects, we develop a probabilistic framework introducing the blending entropy, a metric quantifying the ambiguity in matching detected objects to true galaxies or external reference sources. Using simulated data from the DESC Data Challenge 2 (DC2), we characterize blending in LSST data and quantify its impact on cluster lensing cosmology around cosmoDC2 halos. We demonstrate that imposing a blending entropy threshold of $S_b<0.2$ effectively filters out highly blended objects (around 25%), which are especially prevalent near the survey's magnitude limit and are associated with higher errors in shape measurements and photometric redshifts. Applying this cut substantially reduces blending-induced biases in cluster lensing profiles and mass estimates, thereby mitigating systematic errors in cosmological parameters---most notably reducing tension in $σ_8$ estimates. Our method is readily generalizable to other static probes and offers a practical path forward for real data analyses, particularly when leveraging overlapping high-resolution datasets from spaced-based missions such as Euclid or the Roman Space Telescope, where these external datasets can act as reference catalogs to improve the identification of blended sources in LSST data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“混合熵”这一概率度量，量化LSST等下一代巡天中星系图像混合的模糊性，并用DC2模拟证明筛选该指标可减轻混合对星系团透镜宇宙学的偏差。
AI.motivation: 下一代巡天（如LSST）成像深度大幅提升，导致稠密区域（如星系团）中星系图像严重混合，叠加地面观测的大气模糊，污染星系属性测量并造成源混淆，进而给弱透镜与星系团宇宙学带来系统误差，因此需要同时刻画这些效应的方法。
AI.method: 构建概率框架，提出“混合熵”指标，用以量化探测天体与真实星系或外部参考源匹配时的不确定性；基于DESC DC2模拟数据，刻画LSST数据中的混合情况，并评估其对cosmoDC2晕周围星系团透镜宇宙学的影响，同时施加混合熵阈值筛选。
AI.result: 设定混合熵阈值S_b<0.2可有效滤除约25%高度混合的天体，这些天体在巡天星等极限附近尤为普遍，且伴随更高的形状测量与光度红移误差；施加该筛选后，星系团透镜剖面与质量估计中由混合引起的偏差显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 该方法缓解了宇宙学参数中的系统误差，尤其降低了σ8估计的张力；方法可推广至其他静态探针，并为实际数据分析提供可行路径，特别是结合Euclid或Roman等空间任务的高分辨率重叠数据作为参考星表，以改进LSST中混合源的识别。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 下一代星系巡天，如薇拉·C·鲁宾天文台的时空遗产巡天（LSST），将提供前所未有的深度和天区覆盖，使得对弱引力透镜和星系成团等宇宙学探针的精确测量成为可能。然而，成像深度的增加导致星系图像出现显著混合，尤其是在星系团等密集区域。这种混合，加上地面观测中的大气模糊，会污染星系属性测量并导致源混淆。为了同时捕捉这些效应，我们开发了一个概率框架，引入了混合熵，这是一种量化将探测到的天体匹配到真实星系或外部参考源时的不确定性的度量。利用DESC数据挑战2（DC2）的模拟数据，我们刻画了LSST数据中的混合，并量化了其对cosmoDC2晕周围的星系团透镜宇宙学的影响。我们证明，施加混合熵阈值$S_b<0.2$能有效滤除高度混合的天体（约25%），这些天体在巡天星等极限附近尤为普遍，并与形状测量和光度红移中更高的误差相关。应用这一筛选显著降低了混合引起的星系团透镜剖面和质量估计中的偏差，从而减轻了宇宙学参数中的系统误差——最显著的是降低了$σ_8$估计中的张力。我们的方法易于推广到其他静态探针，并为实际数据分析提供了一条切实可行的路径，特别是在利用来自Euclid或罗曼太空望远镜等空间任务的重叠高分辨率数据集时，这些外部数据集可以作为参考星表，以改进LSST数据中混合源的识别。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 该方法缓解了宇宙学参数中的系统误差，尤其降低了σ8估计的张力；方法可推广至其他静态探针，并为实际数据分析提供可行路径，特别是结合Euclid或Roman等空间任务的高分辨率重叠数据作为参考星表，以改进LSST中混合源的识别。（基于可用摘要）

figures.caption_en: Figure 1 : Schematic representation of the Friends-of-Friends matching algorithm between true galaxies from cosmoDC2 (in red) and detected objects from DC2object (in black). Galaxies and objects are represented by dots, linked through edges if they are located within a \(2\text{\,}{\SIUnitSymbolArcsecond}\) radius. Examples of recognized and unrecognized blends, and perfect matches are illustrated.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：cosmoDC2中的真实星系（红色）与DC2object中的探测天体（黑色）之间的Friends-of-Friends匹配算法示意图。星系和天体用点表示，如果它们位于\(2\text{\,}{\SIUnitSymbolArcsecond}\)半径内，则通过边连接。图中展示了已识别和未识别的混合以及完美匹配的示例。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2 : RGB simulated image example of an initial FoF \(3-2\) group refined into \(2-1\) and \(1-1\) groups after the ellipse overlap test, highlighted with the white dashed line. Galaxies are represented with red ellipses. Objects are the blue ellipses.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：一个初始FoF \(3-2\) 组经过椭圆重叠测试后细化为\(2-1\)和\(1-1\)组的RGB模拟图像示例，用白色虚线突出显示。星系用红色椭圆表示。天体是蓝色椭圆。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3 : Blendedness distributions for \(1-1\) (blue), \(2-1\) (red) and \(2-2\) (orange) groups. The black dashed line represents the blendedness \(b ( Mandelbaum et al., 2018a , see) .
figures.caption_zh: 图3：\(1-1\)（蓝色）、\(2-1\)（红色）和\(2-2\)（橙色）组的混合度分布。黑色虚线表示混合度\(b ( Mandelbaum et al., 2018a , see) 。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Distributions of the blending entropy for groups composed of \(n_{{gal}}\) galaxies where \(n_{{gal}}=2\) (first plot), \(n_{{gal}}=3\) (second plot) and \(n_{{gal}}\geq 4\) (third plot). The different colors represent the cuts on magnitude (in \(i\) -band) applied to the DC2object catalog. The dashed lines indicate the maximum values of the entropy \(S_{b,{max}}=\ln{n}\) for groups composed of \(n=1,\dots,n_{{gal}}\) galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：由\(n_{{gal}}\)个星系组成的组的混合熵分布，其中\(n_{{gal}}=2\)（第一幅图）、\(n_{{gal}}=3\)（第二幅图）和\(n_{{gal}}\geq 4\)（第三幅图）。不同颜色代表应用于DC2object星表的星等（在\(i\)波段）筛选。虚线表示由\(n=1,\dots,n_{{gal}}\)个星系组成的组的熵最大值\(S_{b,{max}}=\ln{n}\)。

figures.caption_en: Table 2 : Summary table of the defined criteria to differentiate, good , bad and ugly groups. The number of galaxies \(n_{{gal}}\) and objects \(n_{{obj}}\) within each defined group are indicated. Criteria have been essentially made on the overlap fraction and the absolute difference in i -band magnitudes. In case of multiple object-galaxy pairs, the conditions are verified for all the pairs.
figures.caption_zh: 表2：用于区分好、坏和丑组的定义标准汇总表。每个定义组内的星系数\(n_{{gal}}\)和天体数\(n_{{obj}}\)已标明。标准主要基于重叠比例和i波段星等的绝对差。在存在多个天体-星系对的情况下，所有对均需满足条件。
